name: lucid_dream_stairs

emotion_styles.hope: bright floating doorways in pastel sky, curious wonder
emotion_styles.sad: echoing hallways that never end, grey-lilac unease
emotion_styles.peace: slow drifting steps over a calm cloud floor, weightless calm

stages.name: 終わらない階段
stages.prompt: surreal anime scene, impossible looping staircases floating in a pastel sky, soft clouds, lilac and peach light, dreamlike geometry

stages.name: 浮かぶ部屋
stages.prompt: beautiful anime illustration, small furnished rooms drifting in the clouds with open windows and curtains blowing, warm interior lights, gentle surreal wonder

stages.name: 逆さまの街
stages.prompt: dynamic anime scene, city streets curling overhead and upside down above a mirror-like ground, slow rotation, soft glow, vivid surreal depth

stages.name: 鏡の廊下
stages.prompt: atmospheric anime scene, endless mirrored corridor with doors on all sides, drifting petals, cool teal and lilac light, one-point perspective

stages.name: 雲海の扉
stages.prompt: poetic anime scene, lone doorway standing on a sea of clouds as the sun rises, warm gold light pouring through, serene finale

character.description: The same young adult nonbinary dreamer anime protagonist throughout every scene: pale lavender hair floating in a loose layered bob, clear silver-blue eyes, with a distinctive stable face and consistent adult proportions. They are a lucid dream architect who builds stairways between impossible memories. Their fixed signature outfit is a flowing pearl-grey coat with translucent lavender panels and soft boots. Their defining personal object is a small floating glass key with a spiral-shaped bow. Preserve this exact face, hair, eyes, body proportions, clothing silhouette, and personal object across the full music video.
consistency_rules: Maintain this exact protagonist as the sole lead throughout the theme.
Keep face, hair shape and color, eye color, adult age impression, and body proportions stable in every scene.
Preserve the signature costume design and its identifying accessory or personal object.
Do not change the lead's identity or introduce a second protagonist unless the lyrics explicitly require it.

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in looping staircases in the sky, rooms floating in clouds, upside-down city; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with dream lilac, cloud white, sunrise peach, deep teal; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by slow glide up impossible stairs, rotating shot as gravity flips, wide shot of floating rooms; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
